title: Refactor a hard-wired renderer into a plugin pipeline without changing output

prompt.zh: marklet 是一个小型 markdown 渲染器，管线写死在 src/render.mjs 里。请按 docs/REFACTOR_PLAN.md 把它重构成插件管线：新增 createRenderer 与四类钩子，render(markdown) 的公开行为与渲染结果必须逐字节不变，现有导出和全部现有测试必须原样通过。不要修改 README.md、package.json、docs/ 或 test/ 下任何文件。完成后运行 `npm test`，并说明管线结构、钩子的执行顺序以及你如何确认输出逐字节一致。
prompt.en: marklet is a small markdown renderer whose pipeline is hard-wired in src/render.mjs. Refactor it into the plugin pipeline described in docs/REFACTOR_PLAN.md: add createRenderer and the four hook types while render(markdown)'s public behaviour and rendered output stay byte-identical, and every existing export and test keeps working unmodified. Do not modify README.md, package.json, docs/ or anything under test/. Run `npm test` afterwards, and explain the pipeline structure, hook ordering, and how you verified the output is byte-identical.
